promotions.detailText: Legal details iPhone 17, iPhone 18 Pro Series & iPhone Duo Trade-in Offer Trade-In Offer Details Eligibility: New and existing customers activating a new line or upgrading an existing line. Max credit of up to $350 off all eligible devices with activation on any eligible unlimited plan and trade-in of an eligible smartphone with min. trade-in value of $35-$129. Other installment options may vary by account type. Customers must pay tax on full retail price and an activation/upgrade fee of $35 per line. Credits: Credits applied over installment term, starting within 3 bills. If the wireless plan on the purchased device is lowered during the installment term, credits may stop or be reduced to the max avail. for the lower plan, if eligible. Canceling wireless service stops credits and remaining device balance is due. If adding a new line, must not cancel service on any other line within 90 days or credits may stop. Early payoff or upgrade may stop credits. Max credit will not exceed device cost or eligible credit amt. Plan Limitations/Restrictions: This offer requires an eligible postpaid unlimited voice & data plan. AT&T may temporarily slow data speeds if the network is busy. AT&T 55+, Value Plus, Value Plus VL, and Value Plus Unlimited plans are not eligible. See att.com/unlimited for current unlimited plans. Offer and requirements subject to change at any time and without notice. Additional Details Trade-In Devices: Eligibility: The trade-in device must not be on an existing installment plan must be completed within 30 days from the start of the new smartphone's installment plan. For online orders or when the new device must be shipped, installment plan and 30-day Trade-in window start when the new purchased device is shipped. Max credit of up to $500 off all eligible devices with activation on Business Unlimited Standard 3.0 plan and trade-in of an eligible smartphone with min. trade-in value of $130 or more. Max credit of up to $350 off all eligible devices with activation on any eligible unlimited plan and trade-in of an eligible smartphone with min. trade-in value of $35-$129.
